svg.title: Chlorine and bromine isotope patterns
svg.desc: Six small stick spectra showing the molecular-ion cluster for one, two and three chlorine atoms, one and two bromine atoms, and one bromine plus one chlorine. Peaks sit two mass units apart at M, M+2, M+4 and M+6. One chlorine gives 100 to 32; two give 100 to 64 to 10; three give 100 to 96 to 31 to 3; one bromine gives 100 to 97; two give 51 to 100 to 49; bromine plus chlorine gives 77 to 100 to 24.
